'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Ganden Yanaga LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ganden Yanaga]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).

Handwritten Xerox form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused]]
* '''Username:''' Cam Solusar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
